name: Draft incident postmortems with PagerDuty, Confluence and Slack

parameters.content:
## Draft incident postmortems with PagerDuty, Confluence and Slack

### How it works

This workflow drafts incident postmortems from PagerDuty incident data. It can be started manually for testing or by a PagerDuty resolved-incident webhook. It normalizes the incident payload, retrieves incident details and timeline events, builds a review-ready postmortem draft, creates a Confluence page, notifies the incident owner in Slack, and logs the result to Google Sheets.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure the PagerDuty resolved-incident webhook to call the n8n webhook URL.
- [ ] Add PagerDuty API credentials to the incident details and timeline request nodes.
- [ ] Update `pagerduty_base_url`, `confluence_base_url`, `confluence_space_key`, and `confluence_parent_page_id` in `Set Config Variables`.
- [ ] Add Confluence credentials with permission to create pages in the selected space.
- [ ] Add Slack OAuth credentials with permission to post messages to the review channel.
- [ ] Optional: add Google Sheets OAuth credentials and set the spreadsheet ID for the postmortem log.

### Customization

Adjust the postmortem structure in `Generate Postmortem Draft`, change the Confluence destination variables, and customize the Slack message or Google Sheets fields to match your incident review process. Keep human review before publishing incident reports.

## Start incident workflow

Contains the manual and PagerDuty webhook entry points that start the postmortem drafting process when run manually or when an incident is resolved.

## Set workflow configuration

Defines reusable configuration values such as PagerDuty and Confluence base URLs, the Confluence space key, parent page ID, Slack channel, and optional logging settings.

## Load PagerDuty incident data

Normalizes the incoming PagerDuty incident payload, then fetches the full incident details and timeline events from PagerDuty in parallel.

## Build postmortem content

Converts the normalized incident context into a structured postmortem draft prepared for human review in Confluence.

## Publish and notify teams

Creates the Confluence postmortem draft, notifies the incident owner in Slack, and appends a tracking row to Google Sheets.

nodes.notes: Select PagerDuty credentials in this node. Do not paste API tokens into headers.

nodes.name: Get Timeline Events
nodes.notes: Select PagerDuty credentials in this node. Use pagination if your incidents have long timelines.

nodes.name: Post Draft to Confluence
nodes.notes: Select Confluence credentials. Keep pages reviewable before sharing them broadly.

nodes.name: Send Slack Notification
nodes.notes: Select Slack OAuth credentials. Do not use a hardcoded bot token.

nodes.name: Update Postmortem Log
nodes.notes: Optional. Select Google Sheets OAuth credentials or disable this node if you do not need a postmortem log.
